plan.purpose: source-only foreground-component inventory, not a cipher test
plan.coordinateConvention: integer XYXY, right/bottom exclusive; native row crop
plan.componentOrdering: minimum occupied (y,x) in raster order, per layer
plan.retention: ALL components, including single pixels, border components and background fields
plan.componentGeometry: exact run-length pixel membership, bounding box, area and crop-border flag only
plan.ownership: unassigned; no automatic glyph/background or token certification
